title: List frame
description: The `data` of an `orders`, `positions`, `bots` or `my-trades` message on the panel socket: an array of operations applied in one commit, so a modify chain or a provisional fill replaced by the real one is never visible half-applied. There is no remove: rows go terminal. A snapshot replaces the held set of its topic (for orders, the open and armed manual ones; bot orders remain available through bot and order details; terminal orders stay for History and stay closed). A snapshot whose seq is below what the topic already applied is refused, and after a snapshot a streamed row at or below its seq is ignored, so an order the snapshot left out cannot come back. Runtime obligations these rules rely on: a snapshot includes every event at or below its seq; the current order of a modify chain has a higher seq than its predecessor's close; the ledger seq never goes back, and a reset (for example a new database) requires the panel to reload. Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (ListFrame). See decision 0007 part 2 §9.2. The `bots` topic also carries a third op, `refresh` (decision 0019): the unrealized PnL between steps, not a ledger event.

recentForcedCloses.description: Optional recent forced-close facts; a supplied empty array clears prior facts. Display-only, excluded from all close/increase commands and live balances.

oneOf.description: The bot's value fields between two steps (decision 0019 d4), computed by the runtime in Dec at its pulse (5 s) and sent only for the bots whose unrealizedPnl changed; the apr travels with it, and (added 2026-10-17, 0016 Amendment 10) investedAverage, ownFundsAverage, aprPeak and aprAverage when the row has them. Never journaled. Each entry names the seq of the row version it refreshes: the panel applies it only to a held row with that same seq, replaces only the value fields it carries, and moves neither the row's seq nor the topic's since or snapshot seq. Entries are under `values`, never `rows` or `row`, so a panel that does not know the op skips it.
